biggest_catch: Long Election Day for a flat $220-$325 total; training pay is forfeited if you don't report on Election Day.
catches: Election-day only work, not steady employment.
Long Election Day (Florida poll workers typically serve 6:00 a.m. to close, ~13-15 hours).
Florida statutes require mandatory training before each election; training pay is forfeited if you do not report to your assigned precinct on Election Day.
Must be a Volusia County resident and registered voter (Florida requirement).

steps: Be a Volusia County resident and registered voter.
Complete the poll-worker application on volusiaelections.gov.
Attend the mandatory training class 3-4 weeks before the election.
Report to your assigned precinct and work Election Day.
timing: Election-day only; training 3-4 weeks before each election.
